Avant de préparer un rappel, relisez les: Before preparing a reminder, read the current statuses and file exchanges. A response requesting clarification must stop the repetition of the same message. Test a received document just before the recall, an incorrect document and a replacement after validation. The folder should not move to a quote based solely on the number of files attached; it is the list of verified items that counts.
Collecter les pièces manquantes avant de: Collect missing parts before preparing a quote

Définir les pièces selon le type de doss: Set pieces according to folder type
Exemple illustratif : un projet d’agence: An illustrative example is a project of layout that awaits a photo of the location and indicative measures. The client provides the photo but explains that he cannot measure correctly. The follow-up marks the photo received and prepares a visit decision, instead of indefinitely repeating a request for dimensions.
La préparation d’un devis peut s’arrêter: The preparation of a quote can stop on a missing document or information. A useful automation makes this expectation visible, requires a precise complement and returns the folder to the correct circuit after verification. It should not consider that a received file is necessarily the right piece.
Le dispositif organise la préparation du: The device organizes the preparation of the file; it does not certify the authenticity or technical validity of a piece. The storage and access arrangements depend on the documents concerned. Requests for supplementation must remain proportionate to the actual need.
Site de menuiserie : préparer un projet: Carpentry site: preparing a custom project →
Suspendre les rappels au bon moment: Suspend reminders at the right time
À l’arrivée d’un fichier, enregistrez sa: When a file arrives, record its reference and relationship to the application. Status can go from missing to received, and then checked after checking. A replacement keeps track of the previous version. L的IA may help identify the document type, but a file name or likely classification is not sufficient to certify its content. Uncertain cases remain to be examined.
Établissez une liste courte des éléments: Make a short list of the elements required for each service. Some pieces are mandatory to pursue, others only useful. Associate an explanation and an audit officer to each element. A simple file must not inherit all the requirements of a complex project. Provide a manual decision when the client does not have the requested document or offers other information.
